'''Green Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of Green Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Green Two.

==History==
[[File:GreenTwo-SWR70.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Green Two fighting alongside others during the Battle of Rendili.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Green Two was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], who was ordered to pull away during the [[Battle of Rendili]].<ref name="R70" />

[[0 BBY/Legends|Shortly before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] known as Green Two stationed at [[Anchorhead Base]] flew a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] while "[[Rookie One]]" underwent a training trial through [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]].<ref name="RA">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref>

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Green Two was the call sign used by a rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Green Two (Battle of Hoth)|fighter pilot]] who escorted the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' past [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]].<ref name="XWA" />

After the Battle of Hoth, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew an X-wing starfighter as Green Two for his [[Starfighter Superiority Evaluation]], and returned to the call sign in a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] for combat missions such as the [[Battle of Bettel]], the destruction of the [[Obsidian (XQ1 Platform)|''Obsidian'']], and the [[Battle of Hurrim Base]].<ref name="XWA" />

[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] veteran [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]] flew with [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] as Green Two in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[6 ABY/Legends|Two and a half years]] after the Battle of Endor, [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] pilot [[Ooryl Qrygg]] used the call sign Green Two in a simulation of the [[Redemption scenario|''Redemption'' scenario]] while training to qualify for membership in the reformed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="XWRS" />
